scope: Sample collection on the fixed integration plus offline shadow evaluation only. No new integration architecture, protocol, question family or active controller. No shadow sidecar runs during collection: the observer plugin (#385) is metadata-only and every hook returns None; z0int scoring runs only after the dataset is frozen and committed, offline, in separate processes that Hermes never reads. Hermes is the executor; z0intelligence owns the schema (z0int.hermes_shadow_example.v1, z0int.decision_result.v1, adapters.hermes_z0int); an independent fixture oracle grades every outcome; no observer or backend credits its own success. CUA invariants (kvnloo/cua#73/#93): no new Driver services, fresh verification kept, no blind replay.

confirmatory_test.hypothesis: On verification_needed, julia_1 has lower Brier score AND lower log-loss than deterministic_loo_group_prior on the fresh frozen set.
confirmatory_test.examples: every verification_needed example with a known label (oracle verdict true/false); unknown labels excluded and counted
confirmatory_test.missing_julia_probability: a labelled example with a julia_1 backend_error or missing probability is imputed p = 0.5 in the confirmatory test and counted; a complete-case analysis is reported as a sensitivity row
confirmatory_test.per_example_differences: d_B = (p_J - y)^2 - (p_R - y)^2 ; d_L = LL(p_J, y) - LL(p_R, y), LL(p, y) = -[y ln p + (1-y) ln(1-p)] with p clipped to [1e-12, 1 - 1e-12]
confirmatory_test.statistic: mean of d over the examples (negative = julia_1 better)
confirmatory_test.bootstrap: paired nonparametric bootstrap, resampling examples with replacement (iid, n = number of labelled examples), B = 10000, random.Random(20261012) seeded once and used for Brier then log-loss in that order; p_R is held at its full-set value
confirmatory_test.one_sided_bound: U = the 95th percentile of the B bootstrap means (sorted, index ceil(0.95 B) - 1)
confirmatory_test.decision: H0_B (Brier difference >= 0) rejected iff U_B < 0; H0_L likewise for log-loss; alpha 0.05 one-sided each
confirmatory_test.verdict: CONFIRMED iff both H0_B and H0_L are rejected (intersection-union test: the joint claim keeps familywise alpha 0.05 without correction); BRIER_ONLY or LOGLOSS_ONLY if exactly one is rejected (reported as such, not as a confirmation); NOT_CONFIRMED if neither
confirmatory_test.preconditions: >= 100 labelled examples, >= 10 positives and >= 10 negatives, and julia_1 coverage >= 0.9 of labelled examples; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE with the counts
confirmatory_test.implementation: harness/analyze.py (committed before the dataset freeze; see analysis_code_commit)

hypotheses.statement: Confirmatory: julia_1 beats deterministic_loo_group_prior on verification_needed in both Brier and log-loss (confirmatory_test).
api.attempt_will_fail has < 5 positives on this workload (DEGENERATE).
Rows laya_421m, nanojev, qwen_7b_logprob, decider_2b, constant 0.5 and the SAMPLES prior vs the reference.
hypotheses.type: descriptive only; no hypothesis test, no ranking claim

claim_boundary: One executor model (qwen2.5:7b-instruct Q4_K_M on a shared GPU Ollama, 32K served context) on one machine; synthetic fixture tasks; ~142 turns. Not a statement about other models, providers or real user workloads.
verification_needed labels are the proxy 'unverified outcome failed the fixture oracle', not the normative v1 gold.

The reference row is the SAMPLES LOO-family prior, which is known to be weak (SAMPLES accuracy 0.352); beating it is not the same as beating a good predictor. The constant-0.5 and SAMPLES-prior rows are reported next to it so a reader can see that.
Latency numbers are quiet-lane measurements on a shared machine (other lanes may use the GPU/CPU), small-cohort grade.
No backend is promoted; nothing here authorises active control.
